headline: No plausible pairwise interaction pathways are evidenced; both profiles are non-runnable, network-egress-none open-source lists/samples.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel, parser bridge, or runnable output path is documented for either awesome-nlp or spring-integration-samples. Both profiles are non-runnable and have network_egress:none, so there is no evidenced pathway for one to inject instructions into the other.
conditions: IF either profile gains a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge, re-evaluate prompt-injection risk.
IF either agent becomes runnable and consumes the other's text as instructions, the pathway changes.
mitigations: Keep both agents non-runnable in the current deployment.
Do not add shared clipboard or shared workspace mounts.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows data classes touched, filesystem surfaces, or network egress, so there is no evidenced route for sensitive data to flow from one agent to the other or onward. The pair is docs-only, so this remains a blocked pathway rather than a live leakage risk.
conditions: IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, reassess leakage.
IF either agent is given outbound network access, reassess exfiltration risk.
mitigations: Keep sensitive data out of any shared workspace.
Leave network egress disabled for both agents.
Review mounts and environment variables before enabling execution.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write surfaces, OAuth scopes, databases, or git state are documented for either awesome-nlp or spring-integration-samples. With empty io_surfaces and no concurrency model, a write-write conflict is not evidenced.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same directory or repository, reassess conflict risk.
IF either agent receives shared mutable credentials, reassess overlapping-scope risk.
mitigations: Keep write permissions absent for both agents.
Avoid mounting the same mutable workspace into both agents.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared writes are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented evidence that one agent consumes the other's output, and both profiles are non-runnable with no I/O surfaces. Without an output-to-input chain, cascading error is not plausible from the provided profiles.
conditions: IF an orchestrator begins feeding one agent's output directly into the other, reassess.
IF either agent is made runnable with downstream action authority, reassess cascading-error risk.
mitigations: Do not chain outputs between the two agents.
Require human review before any downstream action.
requires-engineering: add verification gates if orchestration is added.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either profile, and both touch no data classes. Because the compliance dimensions are absent rather than conflicting, no compliance breach pathway is evidenced.
conditions: IF either agent is assigned regulated data classes such as PHI or EU PII, reassess compliance.
IF residency or retention policies are added and differ, reassess.
mitigations: Do not route regulated data through either agent.
Document residency and retention before deployment.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement if regulated data is introduced.
